description: This file contains inline functions and macros related to thread cache (tcache) management in jemalloc, including allocation, deallocation, and cache state management.

methods.name: tcache_enabled_get
methods.description: Inline function to get the enabled state of tcache for a thread.

methods.name: tcache_enabled_set
methods.description: Inline function to set the enabled state of tcache for a thread.

methods.name: tcache_event
methods.description: Inline function to handle tcache events, triggering hard cleanup if needed.

methods.name: tcache_alloc_small
methods.description: Inline function to allocate small objects from tcache.

methods.name: tcache_alloc_large
methods.description: Inline function to allocate large objects from tcache.

methods.name: tcache_dalloc_small
methods.description: Inline function to deallocate small objects back to tcache.

methods.name: tcache_dalloc_large
methods.description: Inline function to deallocate large objects back to tcache.

methods.name: tcaches_get
methods.description: Inline function to retrieve or initialize tcache for a given thread index.
